headline: Records Officer

experience.title: Records Officer
bullets: Manage the archive of land, heritage and civil records dating back to the 1950s.
Classify, index and box records by retention schedule and dispose of expired files properly.
Scan fragile documents and encode their details in the archive database.
Retrieve records for researchers and the public within the same day.

experience.title: Records Clerk
bullets: Filed and retrieved land documents and photocopied records for clients.
Kept the daily document release log.

summary: Records officer with three years managing archives and public records in Occidental Mindoro. I classify, index and preserve records, scan and encode them into our database, and help researchers and the public find documents quickly.

education.credential: Bachelor of Library and Information Science
